nodes.summary: Let $W$ be a set of words in the free group $F(\mathbb{N})$ on $x_0, x_1, \ldots$, defining a variety $\Theta$, and let $X \subseteq \mathbb{N}$ be finite. The free group $F_\Theta(X)$ of $\Theta$ on $X$ is the quotient of the free group $F(X)$ on $X$ by its verbal subgroup, the normal closure of the set of values $\varphi(w)$ with $w \in W$ and $\varphi \colon F(\mathbb{N}) \to F(X)$ a homomorphism. nodes.title: Free group of a variety on a finite set

nodes.summary: Let $W$ be a set of words in the free group on $x_0, x_1, \ldots$, defining a variety $\Theta$. The category $\Theta^0$ has one object for each finite subset $X$ of $X^0 = \mathbb{N}$, namely the free group $F_\Theta(X)$ of $\Theta$ on $X$, and its morphisms are all group homomorphisms between these groups.
